0022600129.text: Detroit comes in 2-0 and first in the Central and the East, while New York is 0-3, 12th in the East, and on a three-game losing streak. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 126-111 win in New York on February 19, 2026. Detroit is without Ausar Thompson (out, ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision. New York is without Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain).
